output.narrative:
Revenue decreased by 1.39% (-7.56) due primarily to an ecpm drop of 0.0855, while fill_rate increased by 2.28% (from 0.77525 to 0.792963). 

The fill rate increase was driven by two independent primary segments: publisher_tier=tier_1 (lift 8.28, explanatory power 1.54) and country=ES (lift 5.33, explanatory power 0.259). 

Within publisher_tier=tier_1, the movement was broad-based, with ad_format=banner showing a lift of 1.0. Within country=ES, the increase was further concentrated in device_model=Galaxy A54 (lift 2.55, explanatory power 0.808) and os_version=Android 13 (lift 2.41, explanatory power 0.791). 

Segments such as ad_format=video (lift 0.64) were checked and ruled out.
